title: 第二十五章 寂灭剑第二十六章 她只是我的妹妹
content_zh:
第二十五章：寂灭剑感受着苏命身上的气息，白玄清双目失神。
“寻常剑道天骄要觉醒剑意，至少都要一年半载。就是曾经的我，也花了足足一个月。可苏命呢，从修行剑道开始，所用的时间好像还不足十天吧？”
“看起来他的剑道天赋，还在我想象之上。”
很快收拾心情，白玄清来到苏命身旁故作平静道：
“剑意一层，倒是没有辜负我的良苦用心。”
对着白玄清深深一拜，苏命诚心道：“这还要多亏了你，若不是你的一剑，我根本做不到这么快领悟剑意。”
“咦！”转瞬，白玄清像是感受到了什么一般，轻咦了一声道：“你居然还将本命剑塑造成功了？”
苏命笑了笑：“侥幸而已。”
白玄清的目光放在苏命的腹部：“掏出来我看看。”
手掌在虚空一划，一柄通体火红的长剑便出现在了苏命手中。
这就是本命剑的特别之处，哪怕没有认主，苏命一样能做到犹如臂使。
而且，本命剑不同于其他法宝的是，它这一辈子只会为苏命所用。
就算苏命死了，旁人也无法将其炼化掌握。
长剑刚刚现身，便发出一阵轻微的嗡鸣，霎时间一股锋利的剑气从剑上散溢出来，仿佛要割裂虚空。
“不愧是通幽玄金炼制的本命剑，刚成型就有了不弱于玄阶法宝的威能。”白玄清笑着看向苏命：“给它起个名字吧。”
“嗯……”苏命仰着头想了想：“我的本命剑是由通幽玄金锻造而成，而通幽玄金又身处苦海峭壁那种死寂危险之地，既然这样，不如就叫它寂灭吧。”
“寂灭剑？”白玄清呢喃了一声，点点头道：“倒是个不错的名字。”
手握寂灭剑，苏命感觉自己身上的剑意都要凌冽了许多。
“有了本命剑，又达到了剑意一层，也不知道现在我再催动九截剑该有怎样的威力。”
苏命眯起双眼，手持寂灭剑猛地斩出。

九截剑催动，刹那间，九道如同与人粗细的剑芒携带着开山裂河的威势划破虚空。
看着眼前那九道巨大的金色剑芒，苏命整个人都呆住了。
自己突破之前，九道剑芒也就手指粗细。
可现在，剑芒不仅变得更大，而且剑芒之中的威力也在暴增。
他无比自信，要是柳关山面对现在自己这一剑，他绝对阻挡不下来。
“明明我的修为没有丝毫提升，但九截剑的威力却是增长了这么多，这也太恐怖了。”苏命喃喃自语。
“这就是剑意的霸道之处！”白玄清凝声道：“剑意能加持剑修的剑诀威力，一层剑意，大致能提升剑修两倍的剑诀伤害。”
“通俗一点说，掌握剑意之前，你一剑能造成相当于十万斤力量的伤害的话，那掌握剑意之后，你的剑威便会暴涨到二十万斤。”
“你的修为虽然没提升，但剑意加持下，伤害却是翻了一倍。”
“再者，你这次催动九截剑用的是你的本命剑，能有这样的提升，并不奇怪。”
苏命轻笑一声：“怪不得你说之前说我掌握剑意的金丹剑修不是对手，原来剑意之强，竟然恐怖如斯。”
“这才哪儿到哪儿？”白玄清不屑道：“这不过才剑意一层。到达剑意二层，剑诀威力能翻四倍。剑意三层，威力翻八倍，剑意四层，威力翻十六倍。以此类推，直到剑意九层。”
content_en:
Chapter 25: The Nirvana Sword felt the aura on Su Ming's body, and Bai Xuanqing's eyes went blank.
"It takes at least a year and a half for an ordinary kendo prodigy to awaken his sword intention. Even I used to spend a full month. But as for Su Ming, it seems that the time it took to start practicing kendo was less than ten days, right?"
"It seems that his talent in swordsmanship is beyond my imagination."
Bai Xuanqing quickly calmed down and came to Su Ming's side, pretending to be calm and said:
"The sword intent is at the level of one, but it has lived up to my good intentions."
After bowing deeply to Bai Xuanqing, Su Ming said sincerely: "This is all thanks to you. If it weren't for your sword, I would never have been able to comprehend the sword's meaning so quickly."
"Eh!" In a flash, Bai Xuanqing seemed to feel something, and let out a soft sigh: "You actually succeeded in shaping the natal sword?"
Su Ming smiled: "It's just a fluke."
Bai Xuanqing's eyes were on Su Ming's abdomen: "Take it out and let me take a look."
With a stroke of his hand in the void, a flaming red sword appeared in Su Ming's hand.
This is the special thing about the natal sword. Even if he doesn't recognize the owner, Su Ming can still act like an arm wielder.
Moreover, the natal sword is different from other magic weapons in that it will only be used by Su Ming in this life.
Even if Su Ming dies, others will not be able to refine and master it.
As soon as the long sword appeared, it made a slight buzzing, and suddenly a sharp sword energy overflowed from the sword, as if it was about to split the void.
"It is indeed a natal sword made from Tongyou Xuanjin. As soon as it is formed, it has a power that is not weaker than a Xuan-level magic weapon." Bai Xuanqing looked at Su Ming with a smile: "Give it a name."
"Hmm..." Su Ming raised his head and thought for a while: "My natal sword is forged from Tongyou Xuanjin, and Tongyou Xuanjin is in a dead and dangerous place like the cliff of the Sea of Bitterness. In this case, why not call it Nirvana."
"Nirvana Sword?" Bai Xuanqing murmured, nodded and said, "It's a good name."
Holding the Nirvana Sword in his hand, Su Ming felt that the sword intent in his body was much sharper.
"With the natal sword, I have reached the first level of sword intention. I don't know how powerful it will be if I activate the nine-section sword now."
Su Ming narrowed his eyes and slashed out with the sword of annihilation.
The nine-section sword was activated, and in an instant, nine sword lights as thick as a man cut through the void with the power of splitting mountains and rivers.
Seeing the nine huge golden sword lights in front of him, Su Ming was stunned.
Before he broke through, the nine sword lights were only as thick as a finger.
But now, not only has the sword light become larger, but the power in the sword light has also increased dramatically.
He was extremely confident. If Liu Guanshan faced his current sword, he would never be able to stop it.
"Obviously my cultivation has not improved at all, but the power of the Nine Section Sword has increased so much. This is too scary." Su Ming muttered to himself.
"This is the domineering power of sword intent!" Bai Xuanqing said in a condensed voice: "Sword intent can enhance the power of a sword cultivator's sword tactics. One level of sword intent can roughly increase the damage of a sword cultivator's sword tactics by twice."
"To put it in layman's terms, before you mastered the sword's will, your sword could cause damage equivalent to one hundred thousand kilograms of force. After mastering the sword's will, your sword's power would skyrocket to two hundred thousand kilograms."
"Although your cultivation level has not improved, with the blessing of sword intent, the damage has doubled."
"Furthermore, you used your natal sword to activate the Nine-Section Sword this time. It's not surprising to have such an improvement."
Su Ming chuckled: "No wonder you said that the Jindan Sword Cultivator who said I had mastered the sword intention was no match for me. It turns out that the sword intention is so powerful that it is so terrifying."
"Where is this?" Bai Xuanqing said disdainfully: "This is just the first level of Sword Intent. When you reach the second level of Sword Intent, the power of the sword arts can be quadrupled. The third level of Sword Intent, the power can be increased by eight times. The fourth level of Sword Intent, the power can be increased by sixteen times. And so on, until the ninth level of Sword Intent."
